children: RNS Number : 2330W  Parvus Energy Efficiency Trust PLC  25 September 2026

The Board of Directors of Parvus Energy Efficiency Trust plc (the "Company") has declared a dividend of 6.5 pence per ordinary share in respect of the financial year ending 31 December 2026, payable on 2 November 2026 to shareholders on the register on 9 October 2026. The ex-dividend date will be on 8 October 2026.
